verdict.rationale: First-party docs show docs.ollama.com serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Ollama API" (openapi.yaml), which the docs llms.txt lists under "OpenAPI Specs". The probe 404s were on ollama.com paths, a different host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads and is complete, and evidence that it covers the OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints as well as the native REST API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: docs.ollama.com serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled "Ollama API" whose description reads "OpenAPI specification for the Ollama HTTP API"
Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
